data.investment_objective: ICICI Prudential Global Advantage Fund (the Scheme) is a Fund of Funds scheme with the primary objective to generate returns by investing in units of one or more mutual fund schemes / ETFs (managed by ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund or any other Mutual Fund(s)) which predominantly invest in international markets. A certain corpus of the Scheme will also be invested in units of domestic mutual fund schemes/ETFs managed by ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund or any other Mutual Fund(s). However, there can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme would be achieved.
